name: High Seat
summary: King Magni Bronzebeard holds court in High Seat, between the Commons and the Great Forge. His advisors and historians gather there, and a sealed passage leads down to Old Ironforge.

sections.title: Heart of Dwarven Rule
sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard hears petitioners and meets with his advisors in High Seat. Royal Historian Archesonus and Senator Barin Redstone stand at his side. From here, Magni directs the defense of the Alliance's northern bastions. High Seat is the seat of power for Khaz Modan, and he leads the kingdom through troubling times across Azeroth.

sections.title: Gateway to Old Ironforge
sections.body: A heavy doorway at the back of the throne room leads down into Old Ironforge. The lower ruins are ancestral halls the dwarves carved before the city was reconfigured around the Great Forge. The passage is sealed and guarded, keeping general traffic from the ancient halls beneath the capital.

faq.q: Who rules from the High Seat?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard rules Ironforge from the throne in High Seat. He hears his subjects and directs the affairs of the Bronzebeard clan. He also coordinates military and diplomatic matters with the Grand Alliance.

faq.q: Where is the High Seat located in Ironforge?
faq.answer: High Seat lies between the Commons and the Great Forge, connected directly to Ironforge's outer ring. Citizens and envoys can reach the chamber from there.

faq.q: What is the sealed corridor at the back of the throne room?
faq.answer: The large archway at the rear of High Seat leads into Old Ironforge, the ancestral ruins beneath the modern mountain city. Access to the lower passages is restricted.

faq.q: Who else can be found advising the King here?
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus and Senator Barin Redstone advise King Magni in High Seat.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you look to High Seat, where King Magni Bronzebeard leads the people of Khaz Modan and carries on their rule.
As an Alliance member, you can look to High Seat for dwarven counsel. Envoys, advisors, and royal decrees gather there.
